accuracy: Names, descriptions and grades follow the official PlayStation list as carried by Exophase and PSNProfiles, who match on all 55. As of 18 Nov 2026 no official list had been published by Rockstar, Sony or Microsoft, so each unlock fact below is checked against at least two of the guides in sources, and anything a single guide alone reports is flagged as such. Five trophies still have no confirmed method — the guide says so rather than guessing.

roadmap.title: Story and side missions
roadmap.text: Play the five story chapters and take the optional missions as they show up — purple map icons, plus black icons with pink letters. As you travel, scan each new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study animals through your binoculars: the 100% checklist later wants 200 of the 277 base vehicle models and 100 of the 255 animals, and studying alone is enough, no hunting required. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia on the morning after the mission Down to Earth (see Positive Mental Attitude — it may be missable), and begin each Stranger mission chain the moment it unlocks. Save separately at the start and end of every chapter: missions cannot be replayed, and you have 15 manual slots plus one autosave. Keep cheats off — they turn off trophies and saving.

roadmap.title: The 100% checklist and Challenges
roadmap.text: Once the story ends, Progress > Stats gains a 100% Completion entry holding 35 tasks. The bars are low — PowerPyx reckons it at roughly 60% of true completion — and most of the progress is already banked from step 1. Only 70 of the 80 Challenges are needed, so skip the ten worst. But every robbery, every underwater discovery, every shooting range, every drone race and the Bret quest are all required. A Long Road, the hardest trophy, unlocks here.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
roadmap.text: Wrap up the eight Stranger mission strands and clean up anything that has not popped by itself. The checklist does not require these quests, so they are usually what remains. Every character tied to a trophy is still present in free roam after the ending, so nothing here can be missed. When the final trophy lands, the Platinum — Vice Got a Price! — pops.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The final trophy: it unlocks the instant the other 54 are all earned. Everything is single-player, there are no online or DLC trophies, and a single playthrough is enough. PowerPyx rates the full set 4 out of 10 and roughly 200 hours, most of it spent on the 100% checklist. On Xbox the same goal is the Mythic achievement rather than a Platinum.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy you cannot miss. It pops when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, at the start of Chapter 1 — just play the story and it unlocks by itself.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: A story trophy you cannot miss. It pops when the Chapter 1 finale is complete. Before you move past Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house — see Positive Mental Attitude, the one trophy that might be missable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: A story trophy you cannot miss. It pops when Chapter 2 is complete. The name is printed with asterisks exactly as PlayStation shows it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: A story trophy you cannot miss. It pops when Chapter 3 is complete — keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: A story trophy you cannot miss. It pops when Chapter 4 is complete. The optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… feeds into Maximum Withdrawal, so take it when it shows up.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: A story trophy you cannot miss, and the gold one: it pops when the final mission is done. Some guides call it Chapter 5, but the official description only names the final mission, so this guide attaches no chapter number to it. After the ending, free roam goes on and everything the 100% checklist needs is still reachable.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story trophy you cannot miss. It pops when the mission Breakfast Run is done — Gamemapa puts it in Chapter 2. Keep a chapter-start save as you go, since missions cannot be replayed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A story trophy you cannot miss. It pops when the mission The Cartel Heist is done — Gamemapa puts it in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story trophy you cannot miss. It pops when the mission Child's Play is done — Gamemapa puts it in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A story trophy you cannot miss. It pops when the mission Headliners is done — Gamemapa puts it in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A story trophy you cannot miss. It pops when the mission VCIA Takedown is done — Gamemapa puts it in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A story trophy you cannot miss. It pops when the mission Operation Savage Glory is done — Gamemapa puts it in Chapter 5.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, and the last big one before the Platinum. Once the story is over, Progress > Stats gains a 100% Completion entry with 35 tasks. The thresholds are forgiving — PowerPyx puts it near 60% of true completion — and most of the work is already banked if you played step 1 of the roadmap properly: scan vehicles, study animals, do the robberies. Only 70 of the 80 Challenges count, and most side quests are not required at all, but every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and the Bret quest are. Expect most of the ~200-hour platinum run to sit here.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game count — jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps. Flying under bridges is reported to be the quickest kind to repeat. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so you will carry on after this pops. Stunt progress is tracked in the Progress menu.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. PowerPyx notes the game itself counts nine activity types, visible at Touchpad > Progress > Activities. One try each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the 12 Shooting Ranges. The 100% checklist asks for the same 42, so this and the checklist advance together. Work through one range at a time and check that range's own medal display before moving on.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — PowerPyx counts 42 races across those spots, so expect several races per location and a win at every one of them. The 100% checklist also asks for every drone race, so this is no extra work on top of the checklist.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 in the game — the same race twice does not count twice. The 100% checklist asks for 30, so keep racing after this pops. Any race type counts, so pick the ones you are fastest at and work down the list.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing contest. His questline begins in Chapter 1, so find him early and follow his fishing challenges through. Winning the head-to-head is what pops the trophy — merely taking part is not enough.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Beat any one of the four video games. Three of them are on the TV at home, so this is one of the cheapest trophies in the game — sit down, pick the game you find easiest, and play it through to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's five quests, then his final mission. This chain is Lucia-only and opens from Chapter 3, so play it as Lucia. Start it as soon as it appears — one guide warns that Stranger chains can have windows tied to story progress, so do not leave it until after the ending.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear all seven shipwrecks for Kenton, then finish his final mission. The chain opens from Chapter 1, so it is one of the earliest side quests you can start. Shipwrecks also count toward the 100% checklist's underwater discoveries, so this pulls double duty.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's five quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub, then his final mission. The chain opens from Chapter 2. Like the other side-character chains, start it when it unlocks rather than saving it for after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full Strangers & Freaks questlines around Leonida. These are the stranger chains — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and more — so this silver pops naturally while you chase the side-character trophies. One guide warns the chains can have windows tied to story progress, so begin each one as soon as it unlocks.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List, then finish his final mission. The chain opens from Chapter 3. Keep an eye out for wishlist cars while you drive around — spotting them during normal play saves a lot of backtracking.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Destroy the labs and finish Tyrone's last quest. This chain is Jason-only and opens from Chapter 3, so play it as Jason. Start it when it appears rather than leaving it for after the ending.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Possibly missable — the only trophy two guides flag. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. This is the one trophy you can possibly miss, and both GTABase and PowerPyx flag it. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning and heads out to the balcony: follow her, accept the prompt, and she shows you how it works. The Progress-menu meditation counter goes up by one, but the balcony is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the others, and PowerPyx has not confirmed whether the trophy needs it. You cannot do it again after Chapter 1 — so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. One honest disagreement: GTABase counts 18 spots while the 100% checklist counts 15, so this guide shows 18 and notes the difference rather than picking a side.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — Jason-only. Which animal it is has not been confirmed by any guide yet, so this guide will not guess: check Bret's questline in game and the guides linked here for updates. The Bret quest is also required for the 100% checklist, so do not skip it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three of the 18 Collectible Card sets. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this silver pops early on the way there. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick up every one you walk past rather than hunting them all at the end.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures around the state. The 100% checklist wants the same 100, so this and the checklist move together. Open the app whenever you arrive somewhere new and scan before you leave.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges, in eight groups of ten. The 100% checklist wants 70, so you can skip the ten nastiest ones and still finish both. Work through the easy groups first — combat, driving and exploration challenges stack up fast during normal play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a four-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then get out of the red heat zone on the map. Bank vault robberies hand you four stars on their own, so this often pops by itself during Maximum Withdrawal. If you want it on demand, both guides point to the same escape: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow you along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. It unlocks the moment you leave the heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted the whole time. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City sit close together, which is why both guides recommend them. The trophy is delayed: it pops about half a minute after you leave the third store, so do not panic if it does not fire at once. If it still has not popped, GTABase says to rob a fourth shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. According to GTABase, scanning 100 different vehicles with WAiNK is enough — you do not need to drive them — and scanning traffic near busy roads is the efficient way to do it. Pair this with the WAiNK habit from step 1 of the roadmap and it pops during normal play.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus first — food, drinks or a shower at home all top it up — bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick gang members at their illegal operations instead. Line the fight up before you trigger Focus, not during it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a docked passenger jet at VCIA and fly about a kilometre away from the airport. The easiest airliner is the one docked at terminals E3/E4. Get in, get airborne, and hold a straight line until you are a kilometre out — the trophy unlocks on distance, not on landing anywhere.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. The official description is only a hint — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and the method comes from GTABase, so treat the air-station location as guide-reported rather than official. Get in, stay in the armour, and let the cannon do the work.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without anyone spotting you. You need the Snap Gun, which arrives from Chapter 3: open the store's back door with it, find the safe code, and clear out the safe quietly. Plan the route in and out before you touch anything — one witness ends the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five of the eight bank vaults and get away. First you need the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — after it, you follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open. Expect four stars on the way out, so have a fast bike ready for the escape. The checklist wants all eight vaults, so keep going after the silver pops.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, take what is inside, and break away before the response builds up — a fast getaway vehicle parked nearby matters more than firepower here.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the entire Leonida map. Flying over the dark patches is reported to be the quickest method, so take a plane or helicopter and sweep the map in strips. The official description gives no area count, so this guide claims none — the job is done when no fog is left.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs — 39 operations exist in total, so you have plenty to choose from. Hit a different gang's operation each time and keep a mental checklist of which gangs you have covered; the trophy pops on the ninth gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown, and no guide has verified how it pops. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but this guide will not invent steps. Check the linked guides for updates as players pin it down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown. GTABase guesses it involves crashing a car out through a showroom window, but that is an unconfirmed guess, not a verified method, so this guide presents it only as a guess. Check the linked guides for updates.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all three key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police. This is a robbery dressed as a bowling trip — grab the valuables, get out clean, and break line of sight until the wanted level drops.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. The efficient way, per Gamemapa: go to the gym together — while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress effectively doubles. Keep both characters training in parallel rather than maxing one and then the other.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. That number comes from a single source (GTABase, via EGamers), so treat it as reported, not official. Everyday criminal activity builds the count over a whole playthrough. One warning from both PowerPyx and GTABase: avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile — it makes the police more aggressive for good.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but no guide has verified what. This guide will not invent a method; check the linked guides for updates.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown. The description hints at witnessing something strange, and GTABase thinks it refers to a strange event somewhere in Leonida, but that is an unconfirmed guess. This guide will not invent a method; check the linked guides for updates.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed in detail — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown, though the description is clear enough: knock someone over with a melee drive-by. The exact trigger has not been verified, so treat the wording as the best available lead and check the linked guides for updates.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your fences (contacts). According to GTABase one fence pays the most, and the total grows naturally during the robberies the 100% checklist asks for — so do not grind this separately until the checklist robberies are done, then top up the remainder at the best-paying fence.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops. This counts naturally over a full playthrough — clothes, food, fuel and gear all add up — and expensive late-game purchases finish it off. There is no need to waste money early; just shop normally and check the running total in the Progress menu.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, about $160,000 in total. The four story garages do not count toward this — only the eight you buy yourself. Save the purchase for when the money is comfortable; garages are also useful storage, so they are not wasted spending.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Any ten vehicles count — use cars you already own or cheap ones you pick up along the way, and register each one as you get it rather than saving all ten for the end.
